projects.title: PR Reviewer AI – Autonomous Code Review Agent
projects.description:
PR Reviewer AI is an intelligent developer tool designed to automate the code review process. By acting as an asynchronous agent, it listens to GitLab activity, analyzes code changes, and provides immediate, context-aware architectural feedback on Merge Requests.

Key Technical Achievements:

• Event-Driven Architecture: Split the application into two independent, containerized services (API and Worker) that share a common Postgres/Redis backend, allowing the system to scale polling and API requests independently.
• Intelligent RAG Pipeline: Developed an optimization pipeline that analyzes raw Git diffs, extracts key components, and builds structured context for LLMs, resulting in highly accurate and token-efficient code reviews.
• Secure & Resilient Infrastructure: Designed a secure token management system using AES-256-GCM encryption. Implemented a Redis caching layer for sessions with a fail-open strategy, ensuring high availability even if the cache goes down.
• API Integrations: Deeply integrated with the GitLab API to fetch contribution events, resolve Merge Request IIDs, and post automated comments seamlessly into the developer's workflow.

projects.title: Polyglot Real-Time Chat Architecture (Chatgram)
projects.description:
An enterprise-grade, distributed real-time messaging platform built to handle massive concurrency. Rather than relying on a monolithic backend, this project leverages a Polyglot Microservices architecture. It utilizes Node.js to efficiently manage thousands of idle WebSocket connections via its event loop, while offloading computationally heavy broadcast routing to a highly performant Go (Golang) service utilizing lightweight goroutines.

The disparate services are seamlessly decoupled using Redis Pub/Sub acting as a high-speed message broker. The architecture features polyglot persistence (using PostgreSQL for relational schemas and MongoDB for high-throughput message ingestion), decentralized media storage via IPFS, and is entirely containerized. The system is deployed via a fully automated, zero-downtime GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline securely routed through an NGINX API Gateway.
